purpose: Identify which native HeadCalc convergence predicate remains active in the scaled-policy retry events after D1 materially restored refinement-route validity.

selection_basis.note: This is outcome-informed mechanism diagnosis, not untouched confirmatory evidence.

telemetry.interpretation_rule: Internal residual scratch and convergence flags are diagnostic implementation state. They are not accepted-state mass evidence when the solve returns retry.

hypotheses.H_D2A: If the remaining D1 retries are still balance-limited, at least one retry event has nonconverged_balance_count > 0.
hypotheses.H_D2B: If head-change criteria now dominate after balance scaling, at least one retry event has nonconverged_head_count > 0 while nonconverged_balance_count == 0.
hypotheses.no_sufficiency_claim: D2 diagnoses residual mechanisms only and cannot itself qualify REF-HIGH.

forbidden: No tolerance changes relative to D1
No use of D2 as untouched primary evidence
next_action_rule: Use the observed retry classification to decide whether a separately preregistered Reference construction can be scientifically justified. Do not relax the remaining criterion solely to obtain 36/36.
